how_to_apply: Download the prescribed application form and notification details from the official website https://mcdonline.nic.in/ by clicking on Recruitment.
Fill up all columns in the application form properly.
Prepare one set of self-attested photocopies of all required documents in the specified order along with one passport-size photograph.
Obtain a Demand Draft or Pay Order for the required application fee in favour of "COMMISSIONER, MUNICIPAL CORPORATION OF DELHI" payable at Delhi.
Report for registration and physical verification of original documents between 09:30 AM and 11:00 AM on 29/10/2026 (Thursday).
Attend the Walk-In-Interview at Mata Gujri Hospital, Administration Department, Block-11, Near Tilak Nagar Metro Station, New Delhi-110018 between 11:00 AM and 04:00 PM.
important_instructions: The engagement will initially be for a period of one year, extendable by one year at a time up to a maximum of three years for PG candidates only, subject to satisfactory work performance and conduct. Advertised posts comprise both vacant posts and posts presently occupied by Non-PG candidates, which are to be filled by eligible PG candidates. If a suitable PG candidate is unavailable, a Non-PG candidate may be considered provisionally and replaced if a PG candidate becomes available later. No private practice whatsoever will be allowed. Candidates who are in service must bring a 'No Objection Certificate' from their Head of Institution/employer at the time of interview. If any vacancy remains unfilled on the date of the walk-in interview, weekly walk-in interviews are conducted every Thursday at Mata Gujri Hospital until all vacancies are filled. Inter-hospital or inter-institutional transfer is not permitted without permission of the competent authority. The appointment can be terminated at any time by either side on giving 15 days salary without assigning any reason.

content_sections.text: Application Form (Filled up) 01 Passport size photograph Original Certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS) Registration certificate of MCI of State/Central / DMC Age proof (10th Certificate) Address proof Valid DMC Registration Medical fitness certificate from Govt. content_sections.text: The engagement will initially be for a period of one year, extendable by one year at a time up to a maximum of three years for PG candidates only, subject to satisfactory work performance and conduct. Advertised posts comprise both vacant posts and posts presently occupied by Non-PG candidates, which are to be filled by eligible PG candidates. If a suitable PG candidate is unavailable, a Non-PG candidate may be considered provisionally and replaced if a PG candidate becomes available later. No private practice whatsoever will be allowed. Candidates who are in service must bring a 'No Objection Certificate' from their Head of Institution/employer at the time of interview. If any vacancy remains unfilled on the date of the walk-in interview, weekly walk-in interviews are conducted every Thursday at Mata Gujri Hospital until all vacancies are filled. Inter-hospital or inter-institutional transfer is not permitted without permission of the competent authority. The appointment can be terminated at any time by either side on giving 15 days salary without assigning any reason.

faq.question: Q1. What is MCD Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD) is conducting a walk-in interview to engage 30 Senior Residents in various specialties on a contractual basis at Mata Gujri Hospital.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 30 vacancies plus 1 PH post across various specialties like Anesthesia, Obstetrics & Gynecology, Pediatrics, Emergency Medicine, Medicine, Surgery, Radiology, and Orthopedics.

faq.question: Q3. When is the walk-in interview date?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 29 October 2026 from 11:00 AM to 04:00 PM, with registration from 09:30 AM to 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the interview venue?
faq.answer: The interview is held at Mata Gujri Hospital, Administration Department, Block-11, Near Tilak Nagar Metro Station, New Delhi-110018.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree and a PG degree, DNB, Diploma, or MDS in the concerned specialty registered with the Delhi Medical Council, or meet alternate experience criteria if PG candidates are unavailable.

faq.question: Q6. What is the upper age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is not exceeding 45 years as on the last day of submission of the application, with relaxations for reserved categories as per rules.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 1000/- for General, OBC, and EWS candidates, and Rs. 500/- for SC and ST candidates, payable via Demand Draft in favour of Commissioner, MCD. PWD candidates are exempted.

faq.question: Q8. Can Non-PG candidates apply?
faq.answer: Non-PG candidates can apply only for Pediatrics (2 posts: UR-1 & OBC-1) or for other vacant posts if suitable PG candidates are not available, subject to replacement if a PG candidate is selected later.

faq.question: Q9. What salary is offered?
faq.answer: Selected candidates are paid under the Pay Matrix Level-11 along with usual allowances as admissible.

faq.question: Q10. What happens if vacancies remain unfilled?
faq.answer: Weekly walk-in interviews are conducted every Thursday at Mata Gujri Hospital until all vacancies are filled by eligible Post Graduate Senior Residents.
